ksudoku.description: i love sudoku. the main reason i jailbroke my kindle. here is the sudoku game that I wanted with notes, and additional settings and QOL things and stuff.

kambience-sounds-1.name: kambience sounds (part 1 of 3)
kambience-sounds-1.author: kylep33
kambience-sounds-1.description: Sound files for kambience: battle, bells, cafe, camp, cave, city, field, fire, forest, forge, horror. CC0 and CC BY recordings from Freesound, credited in CREDITS.md. Installed automatically with kambience.

kambience.name: kambience
kambience.author: kylep33
kambience.description: Ambient sound that follows the story in KOReader: rain on the roof, the fire in the inn, the sea against the hull. Plays over Bluetooth through KinAMP, which you install separately. Books are tagged with the kambience tool on your computer.
